title: GTA 6: Take-Two Bets $8 Billion on Your $80
caption:
Take-Two made $1.6B last quarter (down 18%) but still promises investors $8.0–8.2B this fiscal year, and up to $3.5B in the quarter GTA 6 launches. That gap is your $79.99. Day 2 of our GTA 6 countdown.
Will you buy GTA 6 on day one?

Sources: Take-Two Interactive (SEC filing, 9 Nov 2026), The Motley Fool, Finviz
ig_first_line: Take-Two needs $8 billion this year. Last quarter it made $1.6B. 2 days to GTA 6.
